subject: Re: Customer case study & testimonial — incentives and logistics
messages:
From: Jane Liao <jane.liao@brightco.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood case study / testimonial — incentives?

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Trevor and I were impressed with the latency and cost profile on the 13B model for our reranking workload. BrightCo would be happy to participate in a short written case study and a 10–15 minute video testimonial. Before we lock dates, could you confirm what Redwood typically offers in terms of thank-you incentives?

Specifically, we were wondering whether Redwood provides any of the following for customer advocacy:
- Usage credits (applied to account)
- Branded swag kits for the engineering team
- A donation to a charity on our behalf

We can do a phone call if that's easier — Trevor is cc'd. Also please let us know any logistics you need (signed release, photos, who to ship swag to).

Best,
Jane Liao
Head of Data Platforms
BrightCo

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Jane Liao <jane.liao@brightco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood case study / testimonial — incentives?

Hi Jane — thanks so much, excited to work with you on this. We really appreciate customers volunteering time — here are the options we typically offer for a brief case study + short video:

1) Usage credit: $1,000 account credit applied to your next invoice (standard for written + short quote).
2) Swag kit: Redwood engineering swag for up to 5 people (hoodies, stickers, laptop sleeve) — we can ship domestically or offer e-gift cards if preferred.
3) Donation: $500 donation to a charity of your choice (we'll provide a receipt suitable for your records).

You can pick one or combine (we can do donation + swag but credits + donation together are rare). I'll attach a short options PDF and our swag catalog so you can pick styles and sizes. Once you confirm, Monica will handle logistics for shipments and Marissa will coordinate the testimonial release (we usually have a one-paragraph release, nothing legal-heavy).

We want this to be easy — if you prefer a different mix (e.g., larger donation) let me know and I can escalate. Timeline: we can have swag shipped within 7–10 business days after you confirm; donation receipt within 3 business days after finance processes.

Attachments: advocacy_incentive_options.pdf, swag-kit-options.pdf

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 10:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood case study / testimonial — incentives?

Hi Jane — quick note from ops side:
- For donations, finance requires the project code and charity EIN on file. If you can confirm the charity and EIN we'll route the $500 and send the official receipt.
- For swag shipments please send the recipient names, shipping address, and sizes for each engineering lead. If you prefer digital gift cards, note that in your reply.
- We usually log the testimonial in HubSpot and include a brief release document — I'll drop the link here for review: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/brightco-case-study-brief

If BrightCo would like a modest bump on the credit amount we can consider $1,500 for a short video + written case study, but that requires a manager OK (I'll ask).

Thanks — Marissa
Partnerships & Customer Advocacy | Redwood Inference
